def factor_atr_ratio_vol_adaptive(df):
    """ATR ratio with adaptive short-term window based on volume regime.
    Core idea: volatility expansion (short-term ATR / long-term ATR) signals
    stress; more responsive during high-volume regimes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([
        df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"],
        (df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
        (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()
    ], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    long_atr = tr.rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(
        df_copy["volume"], window=60
    )
    short_atr_5 = tr.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    short_atr_20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    high_vol_condition = is_high_vol > 0
    short_atr = np.where(high_vol_condition, short_atr_5, short_atr_20)
    ratio = short_atr / long_atr.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = -ratio
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    factor.name = "factor_atr_ratio_vol_adaptive"
    return factor
